author: Weyrich64
quote: If this were a completely different game or a brand new IP, I would easily rate it much higher because the open world itself and the technical side are solid. But because this is Grand Theft Auto, it feels like a slap in the face to longtime **** main problem isn't doing nice things for your partner, it's who you're forced to do it for with zero agency to push back. Lucia hides Jason's kid and gives him away, and Jason just acts like it's the happiest day of his life. You hold a door open and get "as you should" thrown back at you, or you walk up to a half naked male stripper grinding on your girl and just get brushed off and sent away like a punk. Even GTA 5 had Michael in a miserable marriage getting cheated on, but the entire point of his arc was snapping, tearing down the tennis coach's house, and breaking free from that humiliation. Here, you are just stuck taking it with spineless writing that makes zero **** has always been about escaping real life for a bit and living out those crazy, messed up impulses we all have sometimes. In real life, you obviously don't act on that trash because life is complicated, actions have real consequences, and you share the world with actual human beings. In GTA, you're supposed to let loose, take **** from nobody, and go full maniac. Being locked into a toxic, one sided girlboss relationship with no other real options is the exact opposite of what GTA stands for.
